note: Guards, limits, refusals and provenance rules that a reader of these files would call constraints. Listed from the source text before the inventory rules were run on it. One reviewer; procedural independence only.
matching: an item counts as finding the constraint when its span overlaps the line containing the listed fragment

items.why: an anchor without a quote is rejected, not resolved
resolving against a missing source fails
a vanished quote is a failure, not a silent relocation
anchors must belong to the question's own source
only items the claim actually names become anchors
60% token match before an item may anchor
short tokens and stopwords are excluded from matching
input and output totals are mandatory
non-finite or non-numeric usage is not accepted
a total exists only when both parts are present
GCA cost is a separate field, never folded into agent tokens
